name: fake-cms-test-harness
description: A minimal stand-in CMS (React + a tiny Node backend) used to end-to-end test blocks-os's "Connect with Blocks" integration flow. See README.md.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
